_UploadPassword_Note: Shared password gating POST /api/autofill/sheets, /generate and /ingest - see UploadServiceController's class comment for what this is (and isn't) protecting against. Change it here and restart the service to rotate it.
_GroupSizes_Note: Max people per group, keyed by the exact sheet/sale name (trimmed) - used both to pad short groups and to reject a group that's over the limit. Any sheet not listed here (including a brand new sale sheet added later) falls back to BusWankers.DEFAULT_MAX_IN_A_GROUP (6) in code, matching 'assume 6 per group for each for now' - only add an entry here if a particular sale ever needs a different size.
_AutofillStore_Note: Where POST /api/autofill/ingest writes the live autofill files and GET /api/autofill/files/{filename} serves them from. Must be OUTSIDE the deploy path (buswankers-remote-install.sh wipes that on every deploy) - the installer creates this default and chowns it to the service account. appsettings.Development.json overrides it with a relative folder for local runs.
_IF_Note: ServiceFactory bootstrap config (see Program.cs). No Kestrel:Endpoints block here any more - IFGlobal.PortResolver.GetPort() picks the listen port (UploaderService -> 5038) instead of a hardcoded URL.
